answer: Equivocation-proof bond stops bulk fake identities. Each identity locks 60 credits and files one signed claim in a glacier ledger, frozen. A lantern auditor pairs claims each epoch: one key signs one claim, so a conflicting second claim proves equivocation and both bonds burn. A dune shift, one key signing two stories, costs 60 each; 1,000 fakes lock 60,000 against a 40,000 pool, a net loss. An honest agent pays 60 once and keeps its full share.
